analysis:
Ksheera Bhagya was launched at Hoskote on 1 August 2013. The scheme provided 150 ml of milk three times a week to children in government schools and anganwadi centres.

The Hindu reported 65 lakh schoolchildren in 51,000 government schools and 39 lakh anganwadi children, about 1.04 crore children in total. The Indian Express later described the same coverage.

The scheme was implemented and continued; the initial three-day-a-week schedule was later extended. The claim is supported by the launch reports and subsequent coverage data.
notes: The quote is the reported scheme description at the Chief Minister's launch, not a verbatim quotation. The Hindu article says milk was to be given three times a week; Deccan Herald describes an alternate-day schedule, which is consistent with three days in a six-day school week. The scheme was later extended to five days a week in 2017.
